IBKR Lite ($0 flat) was the prior assumption under an individual-student-account framing, but Lite eligibility is restricted to Singapore retail investors holding individual/joint/trust accounts with retail-style trading behavior -- it does not extend to an account structured to pitch/manage money for outside investors (a fund vehicle would need an entity/advisor account, which is Pro pricing or better, never Lite). Pro Tiered is used rather than Pro Fixed because Tiered is strictly cheaper than Fixed at every order size (lower per-share rate, lower minimum).
